title: Player that delegates to Song
statement: Define a Song class with a constructor that takes a duration in seconds, and a Duration method that returns it. Define a Player class that has a Song as an attribute, takes the duration in its constructor, and a Remaining method that takes the elapsed time and returns how much is left by delegating to the song. Read the duration and the elapsed time, create the player and write the remaining time.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with classes.
